name: io.github.brilliantdirectories/brilliant-directories-mcp
description: Official MCP server for Brilliant Directories — manage members, posts, leads, reviews, and more.

headers.name: X-Api-Key
headers.description: Your Brilliant Directories API key. Generate one in BD Admin → Developer Hub → Generate API Key.

headers.name: X-BD-Site-URL
headers.description: Your BD site URL exactly as it loads in a browser, including https:// and www if used, with no trailing slash.

environmentVariables.name: BD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Brilliant Directories API key. Generate one in BD Admin → Developer Hub → Generate API Key.

environmentVariables.name: BD_SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your BD site URL exactly as it loads in a browser, including https:// and www if used, with no trailing slash. BD_API_URL is also accepted as a legacy alias.
